Tell me you wouldn't stop and stare at this case 🤤

Sweet potato maple pecan, champurrado churro, matcha mochi donuts and more. They're gone Oct 18.

Pumpkin tiramisu in a mochi donut. Yes, that's a thing now 🎃

Plus mango pandan sticky rice and rose pistachio honeycomb. 6 specialty flavours, gone Oct 18.

Our iced Vietnamese coffee has 2 extra shots of espresso in it. Yes, on purpose ☕️

Too much? The pink drink is dragonfruit, peach and lychee 🩷

Hot take: nama donuts beat regular donuts 🍩

Ube custard, nutella, matcha cream, pumpkin tiramisu and 4 more. 8 flavours this round, gone Oct 18.

Thanksgiving weekend pairing. Pick one 🦃

Sweet potato maple pecan mochi donut with a pumpkin spice latte, or with an extra strong iced Vietnamese coffee.

Do not show up to Thanksgiving empty handed 🦃

Bring your host a box of mochi donuts. Pumpkin tiramisu and mango pandan sticky rice are on our specialty list, and nobody else at that table is making those.

Math that makes sense: 12 donuts for $45 📦

Box of 6 is $25 (before tax). Want specialty or savoury nama in there? It's $0.50 more per donut. Full menu below 👇

Hot chocolate and a churro walk into a mochi donut 🤌

That's the champurrado dipped churro. Sweet potato maple pecan and Japanese Neapolitan are on the specialty list too.

Which matcha are you? 🍵

Matcha yuzu, banana, Vietnamese, or strawberry. Reply with your pick 👇

Can't decide which of our 6 specialty mochi donuts is the best 😭

Mango pandan sticky rice? Pumpkin tiramisu? Help us out.

Cold weather order: a pumpkin spice latte and a mochi donut 🍂

Sweet potato maple pecan if you want to stay on theme, Japanese Neapolitan if you don't.

Introducing the Halloween lineup 🎃

Purple Potion, Mummy, Night Crawler, Matcha Monster, Brainiac and Bloodshot are here until Nov 1. Which one are you trying first?

Meet the Night Crawler 🪱

Chocolate glaze, oreo crumbs and gummy worms crawling out of it. If you still love dirt cups, this one's yours.

Mummy or Brainiac, which one are you picking? 👀

Mummy is original glaze wrapped in white chocolate. Brainiac is strawberry, and yes it looks like a brain.

Pick your hot drink and Halloween donut combo ☕

Pumpkin spice latte, hot chocolate or a hot matcha latte. Tell us in the replies 👇

This donut is watching you 👁️

Meet Bloodshot. White chocolate, raspberry drizzle and a creepy eyeball on top.

Meet Purple Potion, ube glaze buried in Halloween candy 🟣

It looks like a witch's science project and tastes like ube.

Matcha Monster is for the matcha people 🍵

Strong Japanese matcha with googly eyes on top.

We're halfway through the Halloween drop 🎃

Mix and match all six in a box. Which combo are you building?

Hot chocolate or a hot Vietnamese latte with your Halloween donut? ☕

Tell us your combo 👇

Would you eat it?

Rank the Halloween lineup from best to worst in the replies 👇

Purple Potion, Mummy, Night Crawler, Matcha Monster, Brainiac, Bloodshot.

After Nov 1, all six are off the menu.
